cd /testbed && python - <<'PY'
import os, tempfile, coverage
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as task_tmp:
    cov = coverage.Coverage(config_file=False, data_file=os.path.join(task_tmp, '.coverage'))
    cov.start()
    exec(compile('pass', os.path.join(task_tmp, 'ordinary.py'), 'exec'), {})
    cov.stop()
    cov.save()
    loaded = coverage.Coverage(config_file=False, data_file=os.path.join(task_tmp, '.coverage'))
    loaded.load()
    data = loaded.get_data()
    files = list(data.measured_files())
    assert len(files) == 1, files
    assert data.lines(files[0]) == [1], data.lines(files[0])
PY
cd /testbed && python -m pytest -o addopts= tests/test_api.py tests/test_data.py tests/test_oddball.py
